subject: Validate forms using Shiny and JavaScript.

messages.author: 26a97c7c8eef7a04
messages.subject: Validate forms using Shiny and JavaScript.
parts:
Hi all,
Im trying to validate a form using JavaScript so I get a pop up alert instead of a promt in the Shiny shiny-plot-output div. I want the JavaScript to validate a form by just indicating the presence of a "greater than (>) symbol" by using a common JavaScript Script (The entire app can be seen in https://gist.github.com/Tabima/11066911) :

    <script>
    function validateForm()
    {
        /*jshint multistr:true */
    var elementsInputs=document.forms["fasta_file"]["fasta"].value;
        var j=0;
        for(var i = 0; i < elementsInputs.length; i++) {
            if (elementsInputs[i] == '>') {
                j++;
                }
        }
        if (elementsInputs == "" ){
            alert ('No sequence found')
            return false;   
            }
        else if (j == 0){   
            alert('Only FASTA format is permitted');
            return false;
        }

    }
    </script>

I don't know what to do because when I launch the html by itself (not using shiny-server or shiny in R) the popup works... Is there any other validation scheme that can be used?

Thanks.

Javier.
